decision.explanation: Both 'University of São Paulo' (supported by D1S3) and 'Institute of Biology of the Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv' (supported by D2S3) are explicitly stated in the original sources as institutions attended by Radionova Nataliya Vasilievna. These are distinct educational institutions and refer to different phases of her academic career. There is no contradiction in the sources, and both are valid under the requested scope. Fallible audits do not override the direct textual evidence.
